description: Before Nicholas became my child’s caseworker, I felt completely overwhelmed, unheard, and alone. I was constantly fighting to make people understand the seriousness of my child’s disabilities and developmental delays. Too often, I felt like his needs were being minimized and that I was the only person in the room willing to fight for him.Then Nicholas became part of our lives, and everything changed.From the very beginning, Nicholas treated my son like a person whose future mattered. title: Leadership Is Being There When It Matters
